rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: AdRamp provides a free, public MCP server for accessing Google Ads data through OAuth authentication. The server offers read-only access to campaign performance, keyword analysis, search term insights, and budget tracking across any date range. Users can query Google Ads data in plain English directly inside Claude, Cursor, or other MCP-compatible tools without rate limits or API keys.
